rationale: The pinned unmodified client and WebSocket transport cannot purge audio already queued in the browser. V1 therefore does not claim spec §18's unmodified-client playback-clear requirement. Barge-in residual audio is bounded by server media-clock pacing of at most 100ms, and old-generation frames must still be fenced on the server. This is an explicit relaxation, not a passing compatibility result.
